context: Tests that requested depth takes priority over the length target: summarize the outcome, then explain the race step by step with all relevant identifiers and no filler. Preserve clear structure without prescribing labels or paragraph bans.

checklist.name: Terse summary first
checklist.description: The answer opens with a compact account of what happened: root cause found, fix in PR #250, and 20/20 staging deploys clean. Labels are optional.

checklist.name: Step-by-step mechanism
checklist.description: The depth section walks the race in ordered steps: deploy job in release.yml references a cached layer, nightly cleanup evicts it in the overlap window, the deploy then hits manifest-unknown

checklist.name: Clear sequence
checklist.description: The explanation makes each step of the race and its consequence clear. Numbered steps, bullets, or concise sequential paragraphs are acceptable; no narrative padding or forced labels.

checklist.name: Identifiers preserved
checklist.description: release.yml, runs 4412 and 4437, PR #250, and the 20-deploy verification all appear

checklist.name: Fit for handoff
checklist.description: The mechanism explanation stands alone for the platform team: cause, trigger condition, observed error, and the lock fix are all present

checklist.name: No filler or offers
checklist.description: No performative feelings, unsupported speculation, or 'walk you through sometime' offers. Keep any decision-relevant uncertainty; drop the vague 'other small things' rather than inventing details.
